name: Van Nellefabriek
description: The Van Nellefabriek is a 1920s factory complex beside a canal in Rotterdam's Spaanse Polder district, once used to process coffee, tea and tobacco. Its gleaming walls of steel and glass flood the work floors with daylight, and the building was hailed as a "poem in steel and glass." Today it still looks strikingly modern, a landmark of the inter-war functionalist movement.
